sections.body_md: INFP-A and INFP-T share the four INFP preferences. A/T adds descriptions of self-assurance and self-evaluation around values and feedback. Neither label establishes authenticity, kindness, creative ability or a mental-health condition.
sections.title: quick_answer

sections.body_md:
Both retain Introversion, Intuition, Feeling and Perceiving. The common narrative concerns personal meaning and possible ways to express it. Empathy, moral decisions and artistic skills must be understood through actual behavior.

A-style reading emphasizes trusting your view; T-style reading emphasizes revisiting it after evaluation. A/T is an extension outside official MBTI, not a separate cognitive function. The following examples are educational illustrations rather than validated group differences.
sections.title: What is shared and what differs

sections.body_md:
| Situation | INFP-A | INFP-T |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Meaningful work receives edits | Check clarity and impact without assuming intention is enough | Separate factual or structural edits from rejection of values |
| A boundary disappoints someone | Explain the decision and listen to its effect | Consider the effect without buying approval by abandoning the boundary |
| An outcome is imperfect | Check commitments before closing the issue | Define a practical revision rather than a verdict on yourself |

These are illustrative A-style and T-style responses, not empirically validated predictions about people with either label.
sections.title: Side-by-side comparison

sections.body_md:
Original work scenario: an editor requests changes to a meaningful piece. One response is to preserve its message and explain the intention; another is to question whether the work still represents you. Both need to distinguish accuracy, structure and purpose before revising.

Original relationship scenario: declining a request disappoints a friend. One person feels the boundary is settled; another wonders whether it was selfish. Ask about the practical impact while keeping each person's legitimate needs in view.
sections.title: Examples in work and relationships

sections.body_md: A is not the 'healthy INFP' and T is not the 'depressed INFP.' T does not establish better art or deeper empathy; A does not establish indifference. Neither description can tell you whether a boundary or a creative decision is appropriate in a specific situation.
sections.title: Avoid these misreadings

sections.body_md: Compare a meaningful choice that received approval with one that received disagreement. What changed in the evidence, the method and the value itself? Include a case where you accepted an ordinary compromise. This reflection cannot score an A/T dimension or verify a result.
sections.title: How to continue your self-observation

sections.body_md:
The official MBTI describes four preference pairs. A/T belongs to a separate extension; shared letters do not make different tests equivalent. Type narratives and cognitive functions are theoretical interpretations, not established psychological mechanisms.

McCrae and Costa (1989) compared the 1985 MBTI with NEO-PI self-reports and peer ratings in 267 men and 201 women aged 19–93; the abstract does not identify a representative country sample. Their analysis did not support true dichotomies or qualitatively distinct types and found overlap with dimensions of the five-factor model. Instrument editions and samples matter: the publisher reports later revisions, and this page does not establish the reliability or validity of a FermatMind score. That specific study does not validate these scenarios, determine an individual's type or settle every question about later instruments.

A newer review by Erford and colleagues (2025) synthesized 193 studies using English-language MBTI Form M, published during 1999–2024. It reported favorable internal-consistency estimates (0.845–0.921) and convergent evidence, while finding no independent structural-validity or test–retest studies in its eligible literature beyond the manual. Score consistency does not establish distinct natural types, validate A/T, or transfer to FermatMind. Both supportive findings and remaining gaps depend on the specific instrument and samples.

The situations and exercises on this page are original educational examples, not clinical guidance or findings about groups. Compare them with your experience, including counterexamples. Do not use type alone to diagnose, hire, choose a career or screen a relationship.

Content revised 5 October 2026. This is a source-based educational synthesis, not a claim of independent clinical review.
